answer: The crystal counter is kept in voyage and ridge exposes each reset. Someone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 31 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
